schema:name: Utilize digital solutions to streamline healthcare financing and strategic payment processes for improved efficiency and transparency.
schema:description:
This goal involves implementing digital technologies to automate and optimize financial workflows across the healthcare system. It modernizes budgeting, purchasing, and payment cycles by integrating standardized data and analytics platforms.

The intent is to eliminate manual bottlenecks and reduce fund leakage caused by errors or fraudulent activities. It ensures financial resources are managed transparently to support universal health coverage and patient access.

A national health insurance platform that automatically validates hospital claims against clinical records using a centralized rules engine.
